messages:
Priya: Heads-up 1 QuietWorks POC procurement needs final order form + signature path. They pushed a DPA redline for data residency and an MSA change to payment terms.
Sam: Summary I saw: they require EU log residency, an HSM attestation, and Net60. Finance will push back on Net60.
Nora: Legal: HSM guarantee is non-starter. We can provide attestation and SOC2 artifact. Suggest 'commercially reasonable efforts' language.
Carlos: POC team requests a short trial performance note so their infra can approve. Recommend POC appendix with non-binding targets measured in Console.
Priya: Procurement insists on PO before countersign and DocuSign routing by tax ID. Also wants PO field on envelope. Can RevOps accept Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30?
FinBot: Finance note: Net60 requires RevOps approval; otherwise hold. Prefer Net30 or prepayment option.
Sam: I'll prep a redacted KMS attestation and attach SOC2 summary. Nora, can you draft the MSA reply line?
Nora: Draft reply: 'We will provide KMS attestation and SOC2 report; HSM commitments will be provided as attestation only and limited to commercially reasonable efforts.'
Carlos: Proposed POC appendix text: "Trial appendix (non-binding): p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for seq<=1024 on provisioned trial capacity subject to availability. Metrics via Redwood Console."
Priya: Good. Add that it's informational only and not part of the core MSA.
Sam: DocuSign routing requested: QuietWorks legal -> QuietWorks CFO -> QuietWorks procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood RevOps. Use redwood-esign@redwood.com internally. Include PO and billing contact fields.
Nora: Remove any internal exhibits before sending. Also redact internal pricing worksheets.
Priya: I'll send order form with: Net30 OR 30% prepay + Net30 option, attached POC appendix, attestation link, SOC2 summary, and requested DocuSign routing. Ask them to provide billing contact + PO.
Carlos: Engineering note: we can enable region pin + log redaction for trial, will raise ENG ticket.
FinBot: Finance: ask for billing contact up front; otherwise invoice may be delayed.
Priya: Sending now. Will update when they reply. Thanks all :thumbsup:
